name: Bento Pdf
description: Process PDFs entirely in your browser. No uploads. No servers. Complete privacy.
composeYaml:
services:
  bento-pdf:
    image: 'ghcr.io/alam00000/bentopdf:v1.16.1'
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
